findings.body: Once an item has a ready receipt, `forge next` and the session-start context hook now require a successful network fetch. `default_config()` calls `git fetch` without a fallback (repo.py:145), so an unavailable remote aborts the entire report, including guidance for unrelated items. Previously, remote lookup failures were tolerated by `_merged_prs()` (nextstep.py:245–250). Keep status reporting available with conservative human-merge guidance when configuration cannot be refreshed; retain the mandatory fresh fetch in `forge merge`.
findings.title: Preserve next-step reporting when fetching fails

findings.body: This change adds cold-read archiving requirements and revises the MERGE and DOCS task scopes and dependencies. Those amendments are outside READY's allowed paths and are unnecessary for its configuration reader, ready receipts, or command stub. Separate the changes to plans/FORGE-MERGE-1.md, its amended-read record, and the associated story reapproval from this implementation. The required test file and READY's own workflow record serve this task.
findings.title: Remove unrelated story amendments from READY
